headline: Bluesky now lets you hide reposts from that annoying person you follow
summary: Bluesky introduced a new feature to hide specific users' reposts. This tool helps declutter feeds from excessive reposts. Users can now tailor their Bluesky experience.

headline: Costco's great Switch 2 console bundle includes over $100 in free stuff
summary: Nintendo Switch 2 price increases to $499.99 on September 1st, 2026. Costco offers a member-exclusive bundle for $499.99, including the console. The bundle adds a 256GB microSD Express card and Switch Online Expansion Pack.

headline: What to expect from Google's 2026 Pixel hardware launch event
summary: Google is hosting its annual Made by Google hardware launch event for Pixel devices. New slab-style and foldable Pixel smartphones are expected to be unveiled. Leaks suggest updated watches, new earbud colors, and possibly a new tablet.

headline: YouTube is making it harder to earn money on YouTube
summary: Starting February 1st, 2027, YouTube is raising Partner Program requirements. Creators need 1,000 subscribers and 8,000 watch hours or 20M Shorts views. This significantly increases the barrier to channel monetization.

headline: Beat the Summer Heat With This $6 Portable Turbo Fan
summary: A portable turbo fan is available for only $6. It's pitched as an affordable solution to combat summer heat. Stay cool with this budget-friendly gadget.

headline: Final Fantasy Fans Convinced Dirge of Cerberus Remake on the Way After Gackt Posts Photo in Genesis Cosplay
summary: Fans speculate a Dirge of Cerberus remake is imminent. Japanese rockstar Gackt posted a photo cosplaying as Genesis from Crisis Core. This fuels rumors about a new Final Fantasy project.

headline: Arc System Launches Marvel Tokon PC Update, and Some Players Are Saying It's Fixing Most of Their Issues
summary: Arc System Works released a major update for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls on PC. Players report the update addresses many launch issues. The patch aims to improve the game's stability and performance.

headline: Wardogs 'Hits Different' and Could Be the Next Big FPS
summary: A new FPS game, Wardogs, is generating significant buzz. Early playtesters claim it could be a breakout title for the genre. Feedback suggests the game offers a unique and impactful experience.

headline: More than two-thirds of England now in drought
summary: Several regions in England have officially entered drought status. The affected areas include East Midlands, Lincolnshire, and Kent. Over two-thirds of England is now experiencing drought conditions.

headline: New Forest firefighting to continue overnight as cars abandoned
summary: Firefighting efforts in the New Forest are ongoing and will extend overnight. Residents abandoned cars as a major fire took hold on Sunday. One woman feared her family's vehicle might ignite in the blaze.

headline: Record 230 people cross Channel in one small boat
summary: A record 230 individuals crossed the Channel in a single small boat. The Home Office condemned this as "reckless and dangerous tactics." Gangs are reportedly cramming increasing numbers onto unseaworthy vessels.

headline: Trump signs order to limit childhood vaccines and split MMR shots
summary: The Trump administration recommends limiting childhood vaccines. An order suggests splitting the MMR vaccine into three separate shots. Each shot would be administered during different visits.
